caption: The drawing depicts a single lidded vessel, resembling an urn or a tureen, centered within a rectangular frame on a beige background. The vessel is rendered in shades of gray, giving it a metallic appearance, with a bulbous, lobed body that sits atop a rounded, stepped base. It features two large, symmetrical handles on either side, each curving outward and then inward with decorative spiral ends. The lid of the vessel has a stepped, domed contour, topped with a small, reddish-brown knob. The drawing includes subtle shading to suggest the volume and form of the object. The name "S. LISWOOD" is inscribed in small letters at the bottom right corner within the border.
title: Pewter Sugar Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
